topic: GTA 6's Metacritic 99 ties Zelda: Ocarina of Time's all-time record (22 reviews vs 140+)
title: The 28-year-old record GTA 6 just tied #shorts
lines: Which record did GTA 6 just tie after 28 years?
On Metacritic, GTA 6 is sitting at a 99 out of 100.
That beats GTA 4's 98, and the 97 that GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 earned.
Only one other game has ever hit 99: Zelda: Ocarina of Time, back in 1998.
Not quite. Ocarina got its 99 from just 22 critics.
GTA 6 got it from more than 140, with no negative reviews at launch.
Keeping a 99 across that many critics is way harder.
And it took 28 years for any game to catch up.
description: GTA 6 just matched a Metacritic record that stood alone since 1998, but the two 99s aren't quite equal. #gta6 #gtavi #gaming #metacritic #shorts
